description: Lets Sharp Sent send email from your domain: DKIM signing, plus a custom bounce address (MAIL FROM) with its SPF record. Your existing email, your main SPF record and your DMARC policy are not changed.
variableDescription: dkim1, dkim2, dkim3: the three Easy DKIM selectors issued for this domain (32 lowercase letters and digits each). Apply to a sending sub-domain with the standard host parameter.
